title: Why Moon Microbes Aren’t a Sci‑Fi Plot Twist

scenes.text: Recent tests found hardy microbes could survive lunar conditions for weeks
The common belief is that any Earth life would instantly die on the Moon
scenes.label: Life Dies Instantly

scenes.text: Certain spores and extremophiles can endure vacuum, radiation and extreme temperature swings, staying viable for extended periods
scenes.label: Extremophiles Survive

scenes.text: Planetary protection rules exist for a reason
scenes.label: PROTECT PLANETS

scenes.text: Follow to feed your curious mind daily.

description: Discover why microbes can actually persist on the Moon and what that means for future missions. Follow for daily science!
